projecthero.omnitrix.chromastone.crystal: A bolt of light from your hand (24 blocks): 6.
projecthero.omnitrix.chromastone.prism_b: 20 charge: a rainbow beam (28 blocks) that pierces everything in line, 15 each.
projecthero.omnitrix.chromastone.shard_s: Five crystal rays in a fan (14 blocks): 5 to the first creature in each.
projecthero.omnitrix.chromastone.refract: 30 charge: your light splits into rays that strike up to 5 creatures within 16 blocks, 12 each.
projecthero.omnitrix.chromastone.light_d: 10 charge: streak along your look as a flash of light.
projecthero.omnitrix.chromastone.crystal: Pound the ground (4 blocks): 13 and launched.
projecthero.omnitrix.chromastone.spike_b: A ring of crystal spikes erupts round you (5 blocks): 17 and thrown up.
projecthero.omnitrix.chromastone.absorb_: For 5 s EVERY hit is absorbed (no damage) at double charge -- but you are slowed. Press again to end it.
projecthero.omnitrix.chromastone.light_b: 15 charge: a blinding flash -- creatures within 8 blocks are blinded for 3 s and outlined.
projecthero.omnitrix.chromastone.charge_: Let everything stored out in a shockwave (6 blocks): 8 plus a tenth of your charge (up to 18). Spends it all.
projecthero.omnitrix.chromastone.full_sp: ULTIMATE (50+ charge): 0.75 s gathering the light, then a 32-block rainbow beam -- 40, plus 0.6 for each charge over 50 (70 at full). Spends it all.
projecthero.guide.omnitrix.alien.chromas: Chromastone, the Crystalsapien: a living violet crystal that absorbs energy blasts, fire and magic and redirects them as prism light.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.chromastone.ro: Absorber: soaks up energy and fires it back as prism light.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.chromastone.pa: Absorption: energy, fire, lightning, magic and projectile hits are mostly absorbed (he takes a fifth) and stored as Charge (4 per point, up to 100; the HUD's Charge meter).
Light-fed: under the open daytime sky he gains 1 charge every 2 s.
Crystal does not burn: fire never sets him alight.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.chromastone.we: Brittle: blows, explosions and falling blocks crack him for 25% more, and are never absorbed.
His best moves cost charge: with an empty crystal he has only the bolt, the shards and his fists.
A little slow (x0.95), and the charge is lost when he turns back.
